lines.en: "Take that thing off the table, please. Or that I can't use it. I'm just gonna hide it.
Hey, the bathroom checks out clean. Nothing behind the toilet except this Roche Motel."
"You never kill it that way. You wanna separate the head from the thorax."
"Guys, guys, cool it. There he is, there he is."
"Mr. Grotti, we meet again. These are my associates."
"What's this? One of them half-boots. Can't decide what it is. Time to have it."
"If you wanna supplement your coverage, we can do that.
If you wanna replace your current coverage, all the better."
"Hey, you seem like a nice guy."
"Yeah, I'll have the linguine, red sauce on the side. If the sauce does not come on the side, I will send it back."
"I want garlic bread, toasted, not burnt. If it comes burnt, I will send it back."
"I don't really know what that is."
"What he's trying to say is gabagool."
"I don't really think that we have that."
"Shh. I will have the spaghetti with a side salad."
"If the salad is on top, I send it back."
"I don't think our company actually needs any more insurance, so I am out."
"Look closely, Michael. I feel there's a plan here for you."
"Maybe we have a plan for you."
"How about you? Maybe you can use supplemental coverage of some kind. Anybody can get hurt."
"You always think it can happen to you, and think about it."
"Excuse me. Sorry to bother you. Are you a mechanic?"
"My battery's dead. I've got my kid. Can you please help?"
"No, no, no. Come on. I'm sorry. We're having our salad."
"Come on. Lady in distress. Go! Go!"
"Thank you so much. I really appreciate it."
"I'm sure he can handle a simple jumpstart."
"He's trying to force you to decide on a policy."
"Black goes on the red with the..."
"If being a motor drive, it's probably..."
"Just had kind of a long day at the mechanic store."
"So your car's totaled. You're going to want to get a refund on that."
"Or my guy could do it. He's great."
"But I can't do that for you."
"Now, if you could just sign this letter of intent, I'll bring this back to my boss, and we can get this in motion."
"I was just thinking about how, uh, I had this car, this Italian car, and I was driving it, and it kept telling me how much it needed oil, but I wouldn't give it any oil."
"And then one day it exploded, and it killed everyone, and that's what I'm afraid of."
"Aren't you a mechanic? Why wouldn't you put oil in the car?"
"Look, Mike, I don't know what your friends are telling you, but you have to decide for yourself."
"I mean, these guys gonna take care of your things if you die tomorrow?"
"I don't understand. Why would you buy a policy?"
"It's just the cost of a cup of coffee an hour."
"You were man enough to back down, Michael. I'm proud of you."
"I had to make a snap decision, Dwight."
"It wasn't a snap decision. You were sitting there for an hour."
"It was a lot of snap decisions."
"Do you know what snap decision means? It means like this."
